entries.title: Governance Commons Ecosystem Charter
entries.description: Founding charter of the Governance Commons ecosystem. Declares purpose, scope, authority model, and the relationship between GC standards and adopting namespaces.

entries.title: Agent Project Orchestrator — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the APO cluster. Governs the Agent Project Orchestrator protocol: how agents coordinate multi-project work, handoff governance, and orchestration contracts.

entries.title: Agent Team Protocol — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the ATP cluster. Governs multi-agent team coordination: role assignment, communication protocols, and team-level governance contracts.

entries.title: Canonical PASS Identifier Standard — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the CANON cluster. Declares the canonical PASS identifier system: format, alias model, immutability, layer grammar, registry model, external adopter model, and bootstrap acknowledgment. Establishes 8 cluster invariants.

entries.title: PASS Identifier Governance — Normative Specification
entries.description: Normative PASS identifier governance specification. Declares canonical ID grammar (ABNF), ONS conformance, namespace declaration spec (namespace.yaml), layers declaration spec, alias model, allocation authority model, sub-pass relationship model, and immutability specification. 37 normative rules.

entries.title: Registry Governance — Normative Specification
entries.description: Normative registry governance specification. Declares registry file format, entry schema (14 required fields), status taxonomy, write authority enforcement, schema validation contract, append-only changelog, CI integration contract, and dependency validation. 44 normative rules. Companion JSON Schema published at schemas/canon-registry-entry.schema.json.

entries.title: Migration Protocol — eco and GC First-Adopter
entries.description: Migration protocol for the ECO: and GC: namespaces as CANON first-adopters. Formally reverses the unauthorized named-cluster-only rule. Declares ECO: and GC: namespaces and layer bands. Declares assignment algorithm, legacy ID mapping, and conflict resolution rules. Assigns canonical IDs to CANON, ONS, ACES, OG, RT, EV, OPS, REM, APO, ATP clusters. Resolves CANON bootstrap condition.

entries.title: Ontic Namespace Structure — Canonical Naming Grammar
entries.description: Founding record of the ONS cluster. Declares the Ontic Namespace Structure canonical naming grammar for eco and GC-conformant systems. Governs identifier formation, qualification authority, and naming conformance.

entries.title: ONS Lint Rule Catalog and Naming Enforcement
entries.description: Declares the ONS lint rule catalog: machine-checkable naming rules derived from the ONS grammar. Governs CI enforcement of naming conformance.

entries.title: ONS Python AST Naming Enforcement
entries.description: Declares ONS enforcement for Python codebases via AST analysis. Governs how Python identifier conformance is checked against the ONS grammar.

entries.title: Planning Document Standard — Cluster Header
entries.description: Founding record of the DEV-ACCORD cluster. Declares the canonical planning doc types (DEV-PATH, DEV-PLAN, DEV-RELEASE, DEV-TRACKS), H1 naming rule with em dash separator, canonical doc rule, append-only constraint for DEV-PATH, and validation contract enforced by validate-planning.ps1.

entries.title: Planning Document Standard — ONS Registration
entries.description: Registers the four canonical planning doc types (DEV-PATH, DEV-PLAN, DEV-RELEASE, DEV-TRACKS) in the ONS namespace. Adds portfolio_doc_name casing domain and portfolio namespace domain to ons.yaml; creates ons/registry/doc-types.yaml.

entries.title: Execution Model — PASS, RUN, and Evidence Bundle
entries.description: Defines the three-layer execution model: PASS (governance contract), RUN (execution event), Evidence Bundle (audit record). Governing doctrine for all agents operating under GC governance.

entries.title: Agent Onboarding Protocol
entries.description: Canonical agent-agnostic onboarding protocol for all agents operating in this portfolio. Defines reading order, portfolio rules, ecosystem overview, and planning doc roles. Agent-specific bootstrap files (CLAUDE.md, CODEX.md, COPILOT.md) are thin wrappers that point here.

entries.title: Agent Bootstrap Standard
entries.description: Defines AGENTS.md as the canonical GC cross-agent bootstrap file. Separates normative GC requirements from platform auto-discovery behavior, permits runtime adapter files such as CLAUDE.md, and prohibits universal auto-read overclaims.
